mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, create_user_id, create_time, update_user_id, update_time, deleted_at, version, course_id, class_id, starts_at, ends_at, status FROM evaluation_course_schedule WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND class_id = #{classId} AND starts_at < #{endsAt} AND ends_at > #{startsAt} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY starts_at ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, tenant_id, create_user_id, create_time, update_user_id, update_time, deleted_at, version, course_id, class_id, starts_at, ends_at, status FROM evaluation_course_schedule WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, tenant_id, create_user_id, create_time, update_user_id, update_time, deleted_at, version, course_id, class_id, starts_at, ends_at, status FROM evaluation_course_schedule WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND id IN #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE evaluation_course_schedule SET deleted_at = (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), update_user_id = #{et.updateUserId}, update_time = #{et.updateTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{et.id} AND version = #{MP_OPTLOCK_VERSION_ORIGINAL} AND deleted_at IS NULL
